before.answer: Pricing transparency: Checked MonoCode's pinned README, README.md, docs/providers.md, docs/agent-access.md, docs/remote-access.md, mobile/README.md, docs/native/parity.md, docs/native/preview-release-notes.md, docs/jira.md, LICENSE, releases and recent public issues. after.answer: No pricing exists, so no transparency classification applies.

locations.result: Read Install; Get started; Native preview. Desktop installers cover macOS, Linux and Windows. MonoCode uses existing coding-agent subscriptions; parallel tabs/worktrees, editing, diff review and /operator are documented. Production is React/Tauri, preview is Rust/GPUI.

Read Provider setup. Installed Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi and other named CLIs use their existing native logins. Missing providers are disabled individually with installation hints.

Read Enable access; CLI actions. Opt-in /operator gives that active local thread a scoped app CLI. It starts, reads, sends, stops and organizes sessions/worktrees and notes with explicit IDs; uncertain writes retry with identical request IDs.

Read SSH setup; Sessions; Manage host; Scope. Remote Linux/macOS/Windows hosts run provider processes independently of the connecting desktop. SSH setup installs a host service and per-device credentials; remote files/Git/PRs work but operator, terminals and most local-only tools are unavailable.

Read Run locally; Pair; Account selection. The source-built Expo app uses QUIC/mTLS to show desktop projects, send prompts/start/stop turns and view changes. iOS/Android builds require native toolchains; approvals/questions remain on desktop, which must stay awake.

Read Native preview limitations. Preview is experimental, and source presence does not establish parity with production. Native automations/Monos and remote features retain documented verification gaps.
Read Preview 14; Git; Accounts. Native preview release notes cover terminals, sessions, Git views and sign-in fixes; broad real-device parity is not established.

Read Inbox; Automation trigger. Jira Cloud inbox browses issues/comments, starts local work with ticket identity and polls issue-appeared automation. It supports unscoped API tokens, not Jira Data Center.
Read MIT grant. MonoCode repository code is MIT licensed, subject to provider names/logos and notices.
Read up to three latest releases: native-v0.16.0-preview.14 on 2026-11-05; native-v0.16.0-preview.13 on 2026-11-03; native-v0.16.0-preview.12 on 2026-10-31.

Bounded scan of fifteen latest open issue/PR records: #1356 Refine native model, effort and Fast controls; fix background style popup; #1355 Native: resume Operator chats with per-worker completion groups; #1354 Native Operator completion callbacks with per-worker and named notification groups; #1352 Native: give OpenCode v2 /operator threads their own server so app access works; #1351 Native: /operator app access never reaches OpenCode v2 threads; #1350 Native preview: battery-aware animation clock + remote-host project targeting (running fork, happy to upstream). Reports and proposed patches do not establish shipped behavior.
